description: This file defines the ChannelResourceAdminController class within the Goteo Content Management System. It manages administrative actions for channel resources, such as listing, editing, and removing resources via web routes, and interacts with models, forms, and views.

classes.name: ChannelResourceAdminController
classes.description: Controller for managing channel resources in the admin interface, including listing, editing, adding, and deleting resources, with routes defined for each action.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'channels' for organizational purposes.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines routing for list, edit, and add actions for channel resources.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles displaying a paginated list of resources based on request query parameters.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing or adding a resource; processes form submissions and deletions.
